summary: Frontend-only regression for People Mode vibe expansion (iter59). Ran end-to-end Playwright flow on mobile viewport as kauri@intro.demo. VibePicker shows exactly 11 mains in the required order (Open to Chat, Relationship, Coffee/Drinks, Networking, Need Advice, Activity Buddy, New Friends, Going Out, Events, New to the Area, Travelling) each rendered as the same card design with icon+colour+description; `vibe-more-options` card is present, initially collapses `exploring`/`busy`, and toggling reveals both. Save-my-vibe (testID `save-vibe-btn`) with `going_out` succeeded and radar pill updated to 'Going Out'. App auto-navigates to /vibe-details after a new vibe pick and the Going Out form renders 'Specific intention' chips ('Drinks tonight', 'Live music', 'Clubbing'...), When/Looking for/Short context; save button is `vd-save` (works). Nearby filter chips include all new keys and the gym_buddy chip is labelled 'Activity Buddy'; filtering by Activity Buddy shows Liam & Ned with 'Activity Buddy' pill and no occurrence of 'Gym Buddy' in People mode DOM. Switched back to Networking (restored kauri final state). Busy remains selectable under More Options. Professional-mode toggle loads adaptive radar with role-seg-need/role-seg-can (shows one-time disclaimer modal on first entry, expected). One console warning noticed: React-Native-Web deprecation: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' (pre-existing).

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation warning at runtime: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Fired on every screen (surfaces via VibePicker card shadow). Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/index.ts (shadow.card) — migrate to boxShadow for RN-Web or wrap in Platform.select.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Replace deprecated `shadow*` style props in /app/frontend/src/theme with `boxShadow` (or Platform.select) to silence RN-Web deprecation warning across screens.
(Optional nice-to-have) Add a testID on the Save button of /vibe-details (currently `vd-save` — fine, just noting inconsistency vs `save-vibe-btn` naming).
critical_code_review_comments: VibePicker.tsx auto-expands More Options when current value lives in extras — good UX, verified: entering picker with vibe=busy auto-expands.
nearby.tsx FILTERS list correctly relabels `gym_buddy` -> 'Activity Buddy' while preserving key.

vibeDetailForms.ts covers all five new vibes (new_friends, going_out, events, new_to_area, travelling) with distinct 'Specific intention' options — verified 'Going Out' renders Drinks tonight/Live music.
